<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_USI_Registration" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USI_Course_Registration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RegistrationWanted" name="Want to register for a course"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckFreeSlots" name="Check free slots"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_SlotsFree_Split" name="Slots free?" default="Flow_SlotsNo"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesDates" name="Show courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No slots available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Account_Split" name="Account exists?" default="Flow_AccountNo"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check eligible university"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Eligible_Split" name="Eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Account_Merge" name="Account ready"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Tweet_Split" name="Tweet to friends?" default="Flow_NoTweet"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Tweet_Merge" name="Tweet step done"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive course ticket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RegistrationWanted" targetRef="Task_CheckFreeSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckFreeSlots" targetRef="GW_SlotsFree_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_SlotsFree_Split" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsNo" name="No" sourceRef="GW_SlotsFree_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="GW_Account_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Account_Split" targetRef="GW_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountNo" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Account_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="GW_Eligible_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Eligible_Split" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Eligible_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="GW_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Catch_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Catch_ActivationResponse" targetRef="GW_Account_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="GW_Account_Merge" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="GW_Tweet_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Tweet_Split" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTweet" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Tweet_Split" targetRef="GW_Tweet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="GW_Tweet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="GW_Tweet_Merge" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
